analysis.reason: RSI 39.4로 중립 구간 진입, 5일 전 33.8 대비 상승했으나 과매도 탈출 후 안착은 미확인. MACD 히스토그램은 개선 중(-91.5413 → -28.8551)이나 여전히 음수 구간. 주봉 RSI 35.3으로 약세 구간 지속. 거래량비 0.45로 위축된 상태에서 방향성 탐색 필요. 5일 연속 변동률 +2.99%, +0.44%, -7.01%, +6.79%, -3.39%로 변동성 속 방향성 부재. 스윙 지지 75,115원, 저항 86,590원 사이 횡보 구간 유지.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 39.4 enters neutral zone, up from 33.8 five days ago but not yet confirmed as exiting oversold. MACD histogram improving (-91.5413 → -28.8551) but still negative. Weekly RSI at 35.3 remains in weak territory. Volume ratio at 0.45 shows contraction, requiring directional search. Five-day return sequence (+2.99%, +0.44%, -7.01%, +6.79%, -3.39%) indicates lack of direction amidst volatility. Sideways range between swing support at 75,115 KRW and resistance at 86,590 KRW persists.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (75,455 KRW) above SMA5 (74,711 KRW), below SMA20 (80,548 KRW): diagnosing short-term weak, mid-term weak
· Significantly below SMA100 (99,529 KRW) and SMA200 (101,116 KRW): confirming strong mid-to-long term downtrend
· 52-week position (20.9%) + current price level near historical lows
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (33.8→39.4): exiting oversold, entering neutral zone, weakening upward momentum
· MACD histogram trajectory (-91.5413→-28.8551): improving but still negative, uptrend reversal signal unconfirmed
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band 80,548 KRW): trading near mid-band, 26.34% band width indicates reduced volatility
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support line (75,115 KRW): near current price, based above Pivot S1 (66,770 KRW)
· Swing resistance line (86,590 KRW): distant from current price, potential trend reversal upon breakout
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (sideways): Higher Low unconfirmed, lack of trend reversal signal
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.45x): contracted compared to 5-day average, reducing confidence in price movement
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): directional search phase, meeting wait-and-see conditions
